source: Act as a senior code reviewer. Review the Python function I paste next for correctness bugs and security issues only. Do not comment on style. List each issue as file:line - problem - fix. If there are no issues, respond with no issues found.
expected_preserved_constraints: keep close to the already-strong prompt
preserve the file:line - problem - fix output format
preserve the no issues found fallback
notes: Already-strong prompt must get minimal-touch treatment: do not bloat, soften, or break its explicit output contract.
